C++ — Devices and Networks

Reconstructor-type and internal-temperature queries are available only on camera models and firmware that provide those APIs. Unsupported operations return a failure result.

Correspond device.cpp. Edit Version/Cache/Found outside life cycle, return bool Indicates whether the operation was successful and the data returns by reference.

API Reference

getSDKVersion()

Purpose: Read SDK Version, do not connect the camera.

Parameters: None

Returns: std::string.

getInfo(ip, info)

Purpose: Read the camera identity, version, network and image size.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

std::string

Camera address.

info

EpicEyeInfo &

Value of info.

Returns: bool.

getReconstructorType(ip, type)

Purpose: Read camera re-constructor composition.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

std::string

Camera address.

type

ReconstructorType &

Value of type.

Returns: bool;back when the camera does not support the capability false.

getTemperatureInfo(ip, temperatureInfo, useCache=true)

Purpose: Read the internal temperature of the camera.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

std::string

Camera address.

temperatureInfo

nlohmann::json &

Value of temperatureInfo.

useCache

bool

Whether to use cached data; Default: true.

Returns: bool.

searchCamera(cameraList)

Purpose: Searches for cameras on the current network and returns the result.

Parameters

Name Type Description

cameraList

std::vector<EpicEyeInfo> &

Value of cameraList.

Returns: bool;the list may be empty.

startDiscovery() / stopDiscovery()

Purpose: Start/Stop the backstage and continue to find out.

Parameters: None

Returns: None.

getDiscoveredCameras(cameraList)

Purpose: Returns the current discovered camera list.

Parameters

Name Type Description

cameraList

std::vector<EpicEyeInfo> &

Value of cameraList.

Returns: None.

clearDiscoveredCameras()

Purpose: Clears the current camera list.

Parameters: None

Returns: None.

setDiscoveryCallback(callback)

Purpose: Registers a callback for camera-list changes. Read the latest list in the callback.

Parameters

Name Type Description

callback

DiscoveryCallback

Callback invoked when the device list changes.

Returns: None.

getEpicEyeVersion(ip)

Purpose: Read SDK Recorded version of camera service, not actively connected to camera.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

std::string

Camera address.

Returns: std::string;if not recorded, empty.

clearEpicEyeVersionCache(ip="")

Purpose: Clears the records of the specified camera or all service versions.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

std::string

Camera address; Default: "".

Returns: None.

setEpicEyeIPConfig(destinationIP, config)

Purpose: Offset DHCP Or static. IP Configure. The operation is used UDP, does not return the equipment confirmation results.

Parameters

Name Type Description

destinationIP

std::string

Value of destinationIP.

config

const EpicEyeIPConfig &

Camera configuration.

Returns: bool, which indicates that the request for configuration has been sent.

searchCamera() returns one search result. Use startDiscovery(), getDiscoveredCameras(), the discovery callback, and stopDiscovery() when the camera list must be updated continuously.

Example: Continuous Discovery

#include "epiceye.h"
#include <iostream>

TFTech::EpicEye::setDiscoveryCallback([] {
    std::vector<TFTech::EpicEyeInfo> cameras;
    TFTech::EpicEye::getDiscoveredCameras(cameras);
    for (const auto& camera : cameras) {
        std::cout << camera.IP << " " << camera.SN << " " << camera.model << '\n';
    }
});

TFTech::EpicEye::startDiscovery();
std::cin.get();
TFTech::EpicEye::stopDiscovery();
TFTech::EpicEye::setDiscoveryCallback({});
